content.description: Two charts illustrate wine excise tax collections between 1998 and 2012. The top chart, "Figure 13.1," displays the total dollar amount in millions for both unfortified and fortified wine excise tax collections, while the bottom chart, "Figure 13.2," displays these same collections as a percentage of total wine excise tax collections.
content.caption: Figure 13.1 Wine Excise Tax Collections by Type

content.description: A bar chart titled "Figure 13.2 Fortified and Unfortified Wine Excise Tax Collections as a % of Total Wine Excise Tax Collections" displays data from 1999 to 2011, indicating that the vast majority of collections consist of unfortified wine.
content.caption: Figure 13.2 Fortified and Unfortified Wine Excise Tax Collections as a % of Total Wine Excise Tax Collections
